description: Records the owner's standing technical authorization so that agents can decide covered technical matters with provenance. It is NOT an owner approval: it never satisfies a request in any owner-decision-requests.json, is never written to an approvals file, and launch-preflight does not read it. tools/r10/delegated-authority.fsx enforces this.

source.title: Indy Init: Parallel Acceleration Directive
source.provenanceLimit: The text was transcribed by the receiving agent from the owner's message in that session. Nothing here is signed by the owner; the owner can revoke or correct it at any time.

covered.quote: Selecting implementation approaches and work-item boundaries.
Selecting implementation approaches and work-item boundaries.
Reordering work to prioritize functional milestones.
Assigning nonoverlapping source ownership across agents.
Creating and merging PRs after required checks pass.
Updating preparation scripts, development workflows, and non-security governance procedures.
Deferring noncritical work while preserving its original requirements and incomplete status.
Selecting the recommended option for routine technical decisions.
Reusing existing approved libraries, packages, and tooling.

reserved.quote: Claiming failed or unexecuted tests passed.
Reducing the fundamental application scope without recording the reduction.
Starting the official timed competition build.
Forging owner identity, signatures, or approval records.

neverSatisfies: Any request id listed in any owner-decision-requests.json in the repository (ODR-*, OD-*, CF-*, ...): those still need the owner's own signed record (RDP-003).
